homeHero.description: Sky Accelerate Group helps businesses navigate regulatory requirements through structured, practical and responsible advisory solutions.

intro.title: Navigating Compliance with Clarity
intro.body: Businesses operating in regulated industries often face changing requirements, layered documentation obligations and multiple authorities to satisfy at once. Sky Accelerate Group works alongside our clients as an advisory partner — helping them understand what applies to their business, what is required, and how to move through the process with structure and confidence.

coreExpertise.note: Our primary area of expertise remains CIDB compliance and registration advisory.

whoWeAre.title: Who We Are
whoWeAre.body1: {legalName} is a Malaysian advisory group focused on compliance and business support for the construction and related business industries. We work as an independent advisory partner, not as a licensing agent or a representative of any government authority.
whoWeAre.body2: Our clients come to us because they need more than a submitted form — they need someone who understands the regulatory process, the documentation involved, the risks at stake, and the overall compliance pathway their business needs to follow.

story.title: A Structured Evolution
story.subtitle: Sky Accelerate Group's operational roots trace back to 2023. The company itself was incorporated in 2026 as the next stage of that development.

vision.title: Our Vision
vision.body: To become a trusted and reliable one-stop compliance advisory group for the construction, industry and related businesses.

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.intro: We support businesses through comprehensive compliance advisory involving:
items: Business and financial support advisory through trusted partners

philosophy.quote: “Compliance goes beyond a one-time service. It is a long-term commitment built on trust, professional expertise, and responsible business operations.”
philosophy.body: We see every case submission as one part of a larger picture — how a business protects itself, plans ahead, and continues to operate with confidence within a regulated industry. That is the lens we bring to every engagement.

hero.title: Services
hero.subtitle: A clear distinction between what Sky Accelerate Group advises and delivers in-house, and what is coordinated through trusted professional partners.

inHouse.title: In-House Advisory
inHouse.subtitle: Services advised on and delivered directly by Sky Accelerate Group, led by our core CIDB compliance expertise.

partner.title: Partner-Supported Services
partner.subtitle: Extended regulatory support coordinated through trusted professional partners where appropriate. These are not performed directly in-house.

hero.title: CIDB Compliance & Registration Advisory
hero.subtitle: Structured guidance for Malaysian contractors navigating registration, renewal, upgrading and related compliance requirements.

contractor.title: Contractor Registration & Compliance Advisory
contractor.subtitle: We help clients understand eligibility, documentation, registration requirements and the overall application pathway — rather than simply lodging a form on their behalf.

items.title: New Registration
items.body: Advisory on eligibility, applicable category and grade, and the documentation required to prepare a structured submission.

items.title: Renewal
items.body: Review of renewal timelines and updated documentation requirements to support a timely, well-organised submission.

items.title: Grade Upgrade
items.body: Assessment of financial, technical and personnel criteria relevant to the desired grade band, with guidance on closing documentation gaps.

items.title: Related Applications
items.body: Advisory support on other contractor-related applications and submissions as they arise.

personnel.title: CIDB Personnel Registration
personnel.subtitle: Positioned as part of a company's broader workforce and personnel compliance, not a standalone paperwork exercise.

items.title: New Registration
items.body: Guidance on personnel registration requirements as part of overall workforce compliance.

items.title: Renewal
items.body: Support in tracking renewal timelines and preparing the relevant documentation.

items.title: Related Applications
items.body: Advisory on other personnel-related registration matters as required.

products.title: Product & Material Compliance
products.subtitle: Currently available as regulatory consultation and compliance guidance.
products.consultationBody: Advisory on the regulatory considerations relevant to product and material compliance within the construction sector.
products.guidanceBody: General guidance to help clients understand applicable compliance expectations for products and materials.
products.note: Application handling for CIDB product and material compliance is currently not available. Our role in this area is limited to regulatory consultation and compliance guidance.

documents.title: Information Commonly Required
items: Financial statements and supporting financial records
Technical personnel and project experience details
Prior registration or licensing history, where applicable
documents.note: Requirements may vary depending on company circumstances and prevailing regulatory requirements. We confirm the exact documentation needed during our initial assessment.

items.q: Does Sky Accelerate Group guarantee approval of a CIDB application?
items.a: No. Approvals remain at the sole discretion of CIDB and are subject to the applicable requirements at the time of submission. We provide structured advisory and preparation support — we do not represent CIDB and cannot guarantee outcomes or processing timelines.

items.q: Is Sky Accelerate Group affiliated with CIDB?
items.a: No. Sky Accelerate Group is an independent advisory company and is not a government authority or an official representative of CIDB.

This varies depending on the type of application and the company's current standing. Requirements may vary depending on company circumstances and prevailing regulatory requirements — we review this individually with each client.

items.q: Can Sky Accelerate Group handle CIDB product and material compliance applications?
items.a: Not at this time. We currently provide regulatory consultation and compliance guidance for product and material compliance matters, but application handling for this category is not yet available.

PrivacyPolicyPage.title: Privacy Policy
PrivacyPolicyPage.intro: {legalName} ({registrationNo}) (“Sky Accelerate Group”, “we”, “us” or “our”) respects the privacy of individuals who interact with us, including visitors to our website and clients who engage our advisory services. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, disclose and protect personal data in connection with our services and this website.

sections.title: Information We Collect
paragraphs: We may collect personal data that you voluntarily provide to us, including your name, company name, phone number, email address, the service you are enquiring about, and any message or supporting information you choose to share through our contact form, email, phone or WhatsApp.
Where you engage us for advisory services, we may also collect business, financial and documentation-related information necessary to provide the relevant compliance advisory.

sections.title: How We Use Your Information
sections.intro: We use the personal data we collect to:
list: Respond to enquiries and consultation requests;
Provide, manage and deliver our advisory services;
Communicate with you regarding your engagement, including follow-up guidance;
Comply with applicable legal and regulatory obligations;
Improve our website and services, where data is used in an aggregated or anonymised form.

sections.title: Disclosure to Third Parties
paragraphs: For certain partner-supported services, we may need to share relevant information with trusted professional partners who assist in coordinating the applicable process (for example, corporate registration or construction-related regulatory support). We only share the information reasonably necessary for this purpose.
We do not sell personal data to third parties for marketing purposes.

sections.title: Data Retention
paragraphs: We retain personal data for as long as necessary to fulfil the purposes described in this Policy, or as required by applicable law, after which it is securely disposed of or anonymised.

sections.title: Your Rights
paragraphs: Subject to applicable law, you may request access to, correction of, or deletion of your personal data held by us. You may also withdraw consent to our processing of your data, where applicable, by contacting us using the details below.

sections.title: Contact Us
paragraphs: For questions regarding this Privacy Policy or how your personal data is handled, please contact us at {email} or {phone}.

TermsOfUsePage.title: Terms of Use
TermsOfUsePage.intro: These Terms of Use govern your access to and use of the website operated by {legalName} ({registrationNo}) at {domain} (the “Website”). By accessing or using the Website, you agree to be bound by these Terms.

sections.title: Purpose of the Website
paragraphs: This Website is provided to give general information about Sky Accelerate Group and our advisory services. Content on this Website is for informational purposes only and does not constitute legal, financial or regulatory advice.

sections.title: No Guarantee of Outcome
paragraphs: Nothing on this Website constitutes a guarantee of approval, licence issuance, registration outcome or processing timeline by any regulatory authority. Regulatory outcomes remain at the sole discretion of the relevant authorities.

sections.title: Intellectual Property
paragraphs: All content on this Website, including text, graphics, logos and layout, is the property of {legalName} unless otherwise stated, and may not be reproduced or used without our prior written consent.

sections.title: Third-Party Links and References
paragraphs: References to regulatory authorities such as CIDB, MOF, JKKP, SPAN or SSM are made solely in relation to their respective regulatory functions. Such references do not imply affiliation, appointment, endorsement or partnership between Sky Accelerate Group and those authorities.

sections.title: Limitation of Liability
paragraphs: To the fullest extent permitted by law, {legalName} shall not be liable for any loss or damage arising from your use of, or reliance on, information provided on this Website. Specific advisory engagements are governed by the separate terms agreed with each client.

sections.title: Changes to These Terms
paragraphs: We may update these Terms of Use from time to time. Continued use of the Website after changes are posted constitutes acceptance of the revised Terms.

sections.title: Governing Law
paragraphs: These Terms are governed by the laws of Malaysia, without regard to conflict of law principles.

sections.title: Independent Advisory Status
paragraphs: {legalName} ({registrationNo}) is an independent advisory company. We are not a government authority, department or agency, and we are not an official representative of CIDB, MOF, JKKP, SPAN, SSM or any other Malaysian regulatory authority unless specifically stated and legally authorised.

sections.title: No Guarantee of Outcome
paragraphs: We provide structured, practical and responsible advisory services relating to regulatory compliance. We do not guarantee approval, licence issuance, registration outcome, grade determination or any specific processing timeline. All regulatory outcomes remain subject to the assessment and discretion of the relevant authorities.

sections.title: Partner-Supported Services
paragraphs: Certain services described on this Website — including corporate registration support, JKKP, MOF and SPAN-related support, and other licensing or permit support — are coordinated through trusted professional partners rather than performed directly in-house. Where this applies, it is clearly indicated on the relevant service description.

sections.title: General Information Only
paragraphs: Content on this Website, including our Insights section, is provided for general informational purposes and reflects our understanding at the time of publication. Regulatory requirements may change, and requirements may vary depending on company circumstances and prevailing regulatory requirements. We recommend obtaining specific advice for your situation before taking action.

sections.title: Case Reviews
paragraphs: Case reviews published on this Website are anonymised and presented for illustrative purposes. Results vary according to circumstances and applicable regulatory requirements, and past outcomes do not guarantee similar results for other clients.

sections.title: Contact
paragraphs: If you have any questions about this Disclaimer, please contact us at {email}.
